notes.title: New version of BB
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the latest news of BattleBeasts.
New vision of BB is survival-sandbox, the events take place in the island of square 8*8 km.
As a result of extraordinary events prisoners have escaped of prison
Using space rescue capsules, prisoners enter an island with an abandoned space base on the planet, where they have to survive, having at their arsenal a minimum of tools.
And teaming will give more chances for survival.
BattleBeasts is an sandbox-shooter with open world, where foxes, raccoons, tigers, wolfs and other sentient beasts of the galaxy fight for survival.
Travel, explore the locations, fight with NPC-enemies and each other. In the world of BattleBeasts you are free to go in any direction, to study all the corners of the game world, build your fortifications and bases, choose your style of survival.
What's new in alpha 3.0:
• We removed classes and abilities, in order to remove the imbalance among the players.
• Redesigned the graphics so that all players could play without affecting the graphics on the balance of the game.
• Your accounts will become universal for all our servers, and characters will remain assigned to your account.
• Balancing gaming servers and running cards will keep the server full.
• The game balance system will not allow top players to dominate the newcomers.
• The system of gaining experience by the player became more saturated by reducing the time for the drawing of objects. The objects themselves became several times larger.
• New managed bots and drones are introduced into the game balance, drawings can be studied, build their own bots and give them tasks.
• Hover is the only vehicle.
